links.outcome: Readability of chatbot drug information answers measured with Flesch Reading Ease Score
links.effect: Overall readability implied responses were difficult to read on the Flesch Reading Ease Score across 500 answers; complexity may limit patient understanding.
links.quote: Of 500 generated chatbot answers, overall readability implied that responses were difficult to read according to the Flesch Reading Ease Score.

links.outcome: Potential patient harm from inaccurate chatbot drug information answers, rated by experts
links.effect: Of 20 inaccurate answers, 66% (95% CI 50% to 85%) were potentially harmful; 42% moderate to mild harm, 22% severe harm or death.
links.quote: Of the subset of 20 chatbot answers, experts found 66% (95% CI 50% to 85%) to be potentially harmful.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of Bing Copilot's answers to patient questions on top prescribed drugs, assessing accuracy, completeness, readability, and risk of harm without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
